# Wipe › Pattern

**What belongs here.** Many small edges at once, in a grid or repeat.

**Examples.** blinds, checkerboard, halftone, stripes

**Family test.** Is there an edge with A on one side and B on the other, travelling until B fills the frame?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Halftone Wipe](halftone-wipe/) | A wave of dots grows across the frame, from tiny to touching, with the new scene inside them. |
| [Stripe Wipe](stripe-wipe/) | Diagonal stripes of the new scene open one after another and widen until they join. |
